summary: The proposal exceeds the allowed length (12 pages vs. 4-6) and one objective subsection (4.1) lacks the required two paragraphs. All other sections, citations, figures, schedule, and AI transparency statement meet the group guidelines.

findings.title: Proposal exceeds maximum length
findings.description: The proposal spans 12 pages, exceeding the allowed 4‑6 pages of textual content.

findings.title: Insufficient paragraph count in objective subsection
findings.description: Objective subsection 4.1 contains only a single paragraph; each objective subsection must have at least two paragraphs.

locations.section: 4.1 Unify Heterogeneous Resources in One Tree
locations.quote: I model   the  resources    as a  tree whose    folders  pass   maintainership,      audit  policy,                     and   grants   down    to  leaves  bound     to target   systems,    as  the  UML     object   diagram in Figure 2 shows.
